hooks.text: Kya aapke WhatsApp par customer enquiries roz bina reply ke chhoot rahi hain?
Toolradar ke mutabiq sirf 20% AI tools bina setup ke sahi price batate hain.
Raat ko customer ne WhatsApp par rate pucha aur subah tak gayab ho gaya.
Manual tareeke se WhatsApp enquiries sambhalna aapke customers ko dusri dukaan bhej raha hai.
WhatsApp messages aur voice notes mein enquiry chhootne se customer turant dusri dukaan chala jaata hai.
Aapko lagta hai har customer enquiry ka reply turant khud dena zaroori hai.

beats.line: Kya aapke WhatsApp par customer enquiries roz bina reply ke chhoot rahi hain?
beats.visual: Anmol holding phone showing unread WhatsApp message notifications

beats.line: Aap sochte hain ki sab messages khud raat ko check kar lenge. Lekin din bhar ke phone calls aur handwritten notes ko manually sambhalna mushkil ho jaata hai, isliye zaroori leads bina reply ke reh jaati hain.
beats.screen: Manually sab yaad rakhna mushkil hai
beats.visual: Anmol showing a cluttered notebook with handwritten order lists next to a ringing phone.

beats.line: Iska hal hai ek AI chatbot setup karna. Pehle bot aapke rates aur timings customer ko turant batata hai, taaki unhe intezar na karna pade. Phir woh unka phone number lekar saari enquiry ek jagah save kar deta hai.
beats.visual: Anmol typing on laptop, pointing to a clean chat window answering customer queries.

beats.line: Toolradar ki research ke mutabiq, AI assistants ke test mein sirf 20% assistants ne sahi price batayi thi. Iska matlab bina sahi tarike se train kiye bot galat details de sakta hai, isliye structured setup hona behad zaroori hai.
beats.visual: Anmol pointing to laptop screen displaying the Toolradar research statistic.

beats.line: Toh jab aap busy hon ya raat ka waqt ho, customer ke WhatsApp messages aur calls ko pending mat chhodiye. Ek sahi setup se customer ko turant jawab milta hai aur enquiries miss hone ka risk kam ho sakta hai.
beats.screen: Enquiries miss hone ka risk kam
beats.visual: Anmol looks into camera, showing a neatly organized WhatsApp chat history on phone

beats.line: Agar aap bhi enquiries sambhalna chahte hain, toh mujhe DM mein BOT likhiye. Main bataunga ki yeh setup aapke business ke liye kaise kaam karega aur yeh sahi fit hai ya nahi.
beats.screen: DM karein BOT honest advice ke liye
beats.visual: Anmol looking directly at camera, with DM BOT graphic overlay on screen.

posts.linkedin:
A single wrong price quote can cost a small business a customer.

Running a daily operation such as a gym, a clinic, or a café means handling phone calls, WhatsApp messages, and walk‑in visitors at the same time. When a customer asks about package fees, service rates, or weekend timings, the owner often answers from memory while attending to another task. Providing an outdated rate creates confusion, leads to billing disputes, and can quietly erode trust before the relationship begins.

An AI chatbot can answer those routine questions and automatically log each enquiry. The bot is trained only on the business’s approved catalogue, so every reply matches the current price list. It works around the clock on WhatsApp, the website, and direct‑message channels, handling queries about pricing, timings, location, and services.

The setup process is straightforward. First, the owner shares the list of offerings, the up‑to‑date price list, and the common questions customers ask. Next, I configure the bot to respond accurately and to capture the customer’s name and contact number. Finally, we test the replies together and make any adjustments until the responses meet the owner’s standards.

With the bot in place, the risk of accidental pricing errors is reduced and hours spent repeating the same information are saved. Enquiries that arrive late at night receive an instant, correct answer instead of waiting for the next morning. All enquiries are stored in a single, organized place, making follow‑up simple and preventing leads from being lost between chat windows.

The bot is intended for routine enquiries only. It cannot replace personal consultations, negotiate bespoke packages, or handle complex custom requests. For specialised customer requirements, human attention remains essential.

I am happy to discuss how this could work for your business. Payment is required only after you approve the completed setup. DM BOT and tell me what you sell to see if it is the right fit.
posts.bluesky: One wrong rate from memory can lose a customer. An AI chatbot can use the latest approved price list, 24/7. It answers routine questions and records leads automatically. DM BOT to see how it works.

replies.if_they_say: How much does a setup like this cost?
replies.reply: A basic FAQ bot is INR 2,999 and the AI-powered version is INR 4,999, plus INR 299/month for maintenance. You pay only after you approve the work. Quick question: what kind of business do you run, and what do customers ask most?

replies.if_they_say: Can this work for my clinic or gym?
replies.reply: Yes, it works well for clinics, gyms, and service businesses where customers repeatedly ask about timings, fees, and location. What are the two or three questions you find yourself answering most often?

replies.if_they_say: What if our prices or packages change later?
replies.reply: Whenever your rates change, the bot's knowledge base is updated so it immediately quotes only the new approved prices. Do you offer fixed packages, or do your rates change frequently?
